route_note: Take a direct bus or minibus from Sofia's Ovcha Kupel or South Bus Station to Rila Monastery (about 2.5 hours); some services require a change in Rila town.
see: Rila Monastery complex and frescoed church
tour_query: Rila Monastery day trip from Sofia

route_note: Frequent direct trains and buses run from Sofia to Plovdiv in roughly 2 to 2.5 hours; the train station is a short walk from the old town.
see: Old Town cobbled streets and Revival houses

route_note: Take a train or bus to Koprivshtitsa (about 2 to 2.5 hours); the train station sits a few kilometres below town and needs a short taxi or walk uphill.
see: House museums such as Oslekov and Lyutov

route_note: Take a city bus or tram to the Vitosha foothills (e.g. Simeonovo or Dragalevtsi) then a cable car or shuttle up; no long-distance transport needed.
tour_query: Vitosha mountain day trip from Sofia
